verdict.rationale: LM Studio's CLI docs list a dedicated `lms chat` command described as "Start an interactive chat with a model" and "Chat in the terminal". Related CLI commands (`lms load`, `lms get`) support picking and loading the model, which together delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: detailed docs on chat-session options (model selection flags, system prompts, history), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the terminal chat experience.
